prompt: In 2024, assuming that their family has been in the same line of work since they took a surname, what is the major use of the product they make if their last name is Kalkbrenner?
answer: “Kalkbrenner” means **lime burner**—someone who traditionally made lime by heating limestone. In 2024, the largest industrial use of lime is **steelmaking**, where it serves as a flux to remove impurities from molten iron and steel. It is also widely used in cement, mortar, construction, and water treatment.
